workclass: Type of employment (e.g., Private, State-gov, Self-emp-inc)
fnlwgt: Final weight (a statistical weight assigned to each individual in the dataset)
education: Highest level of education attained (e.g., HS-grad, Bachelors, Masters)
EducationLevel: Highest level of the education system completed (e.g., 10th, 12th, Bachelors)
education.num: Numeric representation of the highest education level
marital.status: Marital status of the individual (e.g., Married-civ-spouse, Never-married)
MartialStatus: Marital status of the individual (e.g., Married, Single, Divorced)
occupation: Occupation of the individual (e.g., Craft-repair, Adm-clerical, Exec-managerial)
relationship: Relationship status within the household (e.g., Husband, Wife, Own-child)
race: Race of the individual (e.g., White, Black, Asian-Pac-Islander)
sex: Gender of the individual (Male or Female)
2023.capital.gain: Capital gains for the year 2023 (in USD)
2023.capital.loss: Capital losses for the year 2023 (in USD)
2024.capital.gain: Capital gains for the year 2024 (in USD)
2024.capital.loss: Capital losses for the year 2024 (in USD)
2025.capital.gain: Capital gains for the year 2025 (in USD)
2025.capital.loss: Capital losses for the year 2025 (in USD)
hours.per.week: Number of hours worked per week
native.country: Country of origin of the individual
<=50K: Working hours per week for individuals earning less than or equal to 50K USD
>50K: Working hours per week for individuals earning more than 50K USD
income: Income level of the individual (<=50K or >50K)
